messages:
lina-cs: Pelican Systems onboarding ask — partner demo next Wed. They want APAC peering into SG and a temporary QPS increase for the demo window. Tokens go live same day. Can netops/ops help with allowlist + temporary bump?

sara-netops: Yep. Please paste their CIDRs, exact demo UTC window, and whether they want dedicated peering or NAT fallback. Also confirm auto-revoke window.

lina-cs: Pasting customer details (PII-lite):
```
Org: Pelican Systems
CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/26
Regions: ap-southeast-1 (sg)
Current QPS: 100
Requested temp QPS: 250 for demo window (2026-06-10 09:00 - 2026-06-10 15:00 UTC)
Auto-revoke: 72h preferred
```

sara-netops: Good. Dedicated peering recommended for steady p99; will take longer. NAT via our egress gateways is faster to enable. I'll scope both: request peering and set NAT as fallback. Any SLA needs?

lina-cs: Customer called out p99 <120ms target; they said demo includes streaming replies so jitter matters. Sales asked to prioritize peering, but fallback that doesn't degrade below 200ms.

diego-ops: Creating infra ticket and pre-authorizing temp bump. Opening INF-4802. Provisional settings: QPS=250, auto-revoke=72h. Adding NAT fallback. Will add allowlist entries once netops confirms firewall rules.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-4802 — Pelican Systems temporary QPS increase (250) and APAC allowlist/peering request. Assignees: sara-netops, diego-ops. ETA peering start: 36h.

sara-netops: Adding the CIDRs to APAC allowlist now. Filing peering request with infra-sd; tagging peering-team for dedicated circuit. If peering not ready by T-12h we'll route via NAT and enable prefix caching + kvcache warmup.

lina-cs: Can someone post a quick one-off dashboard link scoped to Pelican's org showing token-level latency + p95/p99 so SE can monitor during demo? Also would like a short runbook for CS to smoke-test connectivity.

diego-ops: Added runbook to INF-4802 and included sample checks:

```
# quick connectivity checks
# port check
$ nc -zv 52.14.23.45 443
# sample API curl (use demo token)
$ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/pelican-demo-checklist (internal).

sara-netops: Shared dashboard link (read-only, scoped): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/shared/abc123-pelican (will rotate after demo). Posted progress on INF-4802.

lina-cs: Awesome — I'll share the checklist with Pelican and schedule a 20-min pre-demo run at T-24h. Also flagging renewal risk: account currently low usage but high strategic potential; mark as "monitoring" — if demo metrics hit targets we'll move to "engaging" and schedule follow-up.

diego-ops: INF-4802 updated: allowlist entries added, peering requested, NAT fallback configured, provisional QPS set to 250 with auto-revoke 72h. Ops will notify when peering completes.

sara-netops: Peering kickoff = scheduled. If anyone needs a temporary HW token or bump in console retention for logs during demo, ping me. :thumbsup:

lina-cs: Thanks all — pinging @pelican-ops for final CIDR confirmation. I'll post post-demo CSAT capture plan and attach notes to the renewal playbook.

diego-ops: Closing loop here — will monitor INF-4802 and post the peering completion timestamp. Good luck with the demo! :rocket:
